news.title: Flat Topics & Per-paper Review
news.body: Reviewed all 58 records against primary sources and reorganized the collection into 22 flat topics. Each paper has one README entry and may match several website topics. The website supports checkbox intersections with search and publication months. Assignment reasons and source-reading scope are recorded in the per-paper review.

news.title: Benchmark Atlas & Infrastructure
news.body: Added 14 works across benchmarks, datasets and infrastructure. The Benchmark Atlas records inputs, executable artifacts, evaluation evidence and scope limits; data and harness resources are linked.

news.title: Initial Collection
news.body: 44 papers and projects covering Code World Model (generation) and Code as Model (understanding), including earlier foundations and the latest October releases.

news.title: Original Research Taxonomy (superseded)
news.body: The initial categories and comparison dimensions were replaced by the flat topic scheme on 2026-10-22.

news.title: Daily Discovery Prototype
news.body: Daily arXiv and GitHub discovery is implemented as a candidate-review workflow. Automated promotion and a full literature-review agent remain future work.
